answer: Faking 10 identities locks 1,500 POA, not 150, because each needs its own kernel: 150 POA staked 12 epochs, non-transferable. New kernels start at the bottom of a canyon tier ladder at weight 0.1, climbing 0.1 per clean epoch to 1.0 after 9 epochs. Every 4 epochs a gale audit samples 20% of kernels; each sampled key must sign a beacon within 1 epoch from a distinct ASN path or lose 30% and reset to 0.1. One egress saves at most one fake per gale, so 10 fakes need 10 egresses at ~20 POA per epoch plus 1,500 POA locked for 10 rewards. Fake one risks 150 POA; fake ten adds a likely gale slash.
